prompt: After Meat Loaf legally changed his name due to a commercial, what was the first new brand launched by the company to whom the commercial belonged?
answer: The first new brand launched by Levi Strauss & Co. was **Dockers**, introduced in **1986**, two years after Meat Loaf changed his legal name to Michael Lee Aday.
